concept: Extending compassion to someone whose circumstances or choices you personally disagree with
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario involving someone in genuine difficulty whose situation resulted partly from choices the adult disagrees with
exercise.reflection_prompt: Can you offer real compassion here without needing to agree with how they got there?
exercise.practice: Adult articulates how they'd offer help while being honest about their own view

assessment.success_marker: adult separates offering compassion from endorsing the choices that led to the situation
